dslRule:
<!id: junit.assert.equality.unboxing>
<!description: Replaces Assert.assertTrue($int == $Number) with Assert.assertEquals($int, $Number.intValue()) for clearer comparison and to explicitly unbox, avoiding autoboxing warnings.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.junit.Assert.assertTrue($expected == $actual) :: instanceof($actual, "java.lang.Number")
=> org.junit.Assert.assertEquals($expected, $actual.intValue())
;;
summary: Replaces JUnit Assert.assertTrue for primitive-wrapper equality checks with Assert.assertEquals using explicit unboxing, addressing autoboxing warnings.
